thread_title: S. rosea 'large, vigorous' Liberty Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. rosea 'large, vigorous' Liberty Co, FL

posts.body_html:
Years back, I grew out hundreds of roseas from liberty Co, FL, and a few were selected out to keep. This was one of them, and while I didn't capture a pic of this plant when it was much larger, it still does look pretty nice with relatively small pitchers. The traps can get very large due to its vigor (ie. it's not a slow growing genetic giant), and it has that classic rosea look to it!

Photos taken 3/29/19, these are last year's traps:






Slightly tubby, which is a good look! Makes me feel more secure about myself, LOL

posts.body_html:
Almost lost this clone but have been babying it for years and finally got to make some divisions this past winter! Hoping to have some available to distribute around September of this year. The color on this thing was a bit surprising: maybe it's just the liberty Co, FL population or something, but I compared this to a few other clones and it is for sure more vibrantly colored than the others!
